adjudication.rationale: In `packages/core/EventManager.ts` within `createAllCalendarEvents`, the new logic iterates `event.destinationCalendar` and, when the needed credential is not present in `this.calendarCredentials`, fetches it directly from the DB via `prisma.credential.findUnique({ where: { id: destination.credentialId } })` and then constructs a usable credential object including `key`, `userId`, `teamId`, etc. There is no verification in this diff that the fetched credential belongs to the organizer/host context (e.g., checking `credentialFromDB.userId` against an allowed user/team), so if a `DestinationCalendar` entry can reference a foreign `credentialId`, this path would allow creating calendar events using another account’s credential.
